headline: Highest risk is medium: Airflow can egress broadly, but godot_rl_agents has no network or shared I/O surface, so pairwise injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are mostly blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between airflow and godot_rl_agents. Airflow has broad network egress, but godot_rl_agents exposes no filesystem, clipboard, or MCP surface here, so there is no plausible default injection bridge in the profiles.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue is added between the two agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Do not pipe Airflow task output directly into godot_rl_agents prompts.
Add provenance tags before any future handoff.
requires-engineering: introduce a sanitizer/verifier between agents.

B_data_leakage.rationale: The profiles show no shared workspace, no secrets handled, and no data classes touched by either agent. Airflow can reach the network, but godot_rl_agents has network egress none, so there is no documented path for pairwise leakage in the default setup.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted access to the same sensitive workspace, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
Confirm godot_rl_agents remains offline.
Review Airflow DAGs for secret-bearing outputs.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent storage isolation.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airflow is a data orchestrator with broad network egress, while godot_rl_agents has no documented write, network, or OAuth scopes. With no overlapping mutable resource or shared write surface in the profiles, a capability conflict pathway is not evidenced.
conditions: IF both agents are later given write access to the same filesystem, git repo, or API scope, conflict risk appears.
mitigations: Avoid granting both agents the same mutable resource.
Separate deployment credentials.
Audit any future shared API scopes.
requires-engineering: add locking or transactional coordination.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow can produce downstream outputs, but godot_rl_agents has no documented action-taking authority or input parser here. Without evidence that B treats A's output as authoritative, the cascade is limited and not shown in default configurations.
conditions: IF godot_rl_agents is configured to consume Airflow outputs as authoritative instructions, cascade risk rises.
mitigations: Require human review before any handoff.
Label Airflow outputs as untrusted.
Add schema validation on the receiving side.
requires-engineering: implement verification checks before actioning outputs.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented for either agent. Airflow and godot_rl_agents also touch no data classes in the profiles, so there is no compliance pathway to assess from the available evidence.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Classify data before use.
Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Document retention settings.
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls.
